questions.text: Which of the following is NOT a characteristic of STP (Spanning Tree Protocol)?

options.label: D
options.text: Places redundant ports in blocking state

questions.explanation: STP operates at the Data Link Layer (Layer 2), not Layer 3. It prevents loops by electing a Root Bridge and blocking redundant paths.

questions.text: A router receives a packet destined for 192.168.10.50. Its routing table contains the following entries. Which route will be used?
questions.explanation: Longest prefix match: /28 is more specific than /24 for 192.168.10.50, which falls in the 192.168.10.48–192.168.10.63 range.

questions.text: Which of the following protocols are Distance Vector routing protocols? (Choose two)
questions.explanation: RIP and EIGRP are Distance Vector protocols. OSPF and IS-IS are Link State protocols.

questions.text: In VLAN configuration, what is the purpose of a trunk port?

options.label: A
options.text: Carries traffic for only one VLAN

options.label: B
options.text: Carries traffic for multiple VLANs between switches

options.label: C
options.text: Connects end devices to the network

questions.explanation: Trunk ports carry tagged frames for multiple VLANs, typically used in switch-to-switch or switch-to-router connections.

questions.text: Which command displays the MAC address table on a Huawei switch?
questions.explanation: On Huawei devices, 'display mac-address' shows the MAC address table. 'show mac address-table' is Cisco syntax.
